questions.question: Please identify the passage in Herodotus supporting the claim about a Scythian custom of selling land according to the distance covered in a day. The published notes to the material give no such reference.

localizations.source: Please identify the passage in Herodotus supporting the claim about a Scythian custom of selling land according to the distance covered in a day. The published notes to the material give no such reference.
localizations.ru: Указать конкретное место у Геродота, на которое опирается утверждение о скифском обычае продажи земли по дневному обходу. В опубликованных примечаниях к материалу такая ссылка не приведена.
